Tailored solutions by department.

HR

Streamline the employee lifecycle with a platform built for flexibility and ease.

  • Automate onboarding, reviews, and offboarding in one flow
  • Track engagement, retention, and headcount in real time
  • Free HR to focus on culture, workforce strategy, and impact

Finance

Plan workforce costs with clarity, accuracy, and confidence.

  • View headcount trends, attrition risk, and growth forecasts
  • Connect workforce planning to budgeting in real time
  • Eliminate shadow costs from churn, burnout, and tool sprawl

Payroll

Integrate directly with HR changes and reduce costly payroll errors.

  • Automate leave tracking and local policy enforcement
  • Integrate with global payroll providers to ensure compliance
  • Minimize manual reconciliation and improve audit readiness

Business leaders

Make faster, data-backed workforce decisions.

  • Access real-time dashboards on headcount, DEI, and attrition
  • Align hiring, retention, and engagement to business goals
  • Use people data to shape strategy, not just report it

People managers

Lead teams better with instant access to people data.

  • Approve changes, review feedback, and manage reviews from one place
  • Track team sentiment, goals, and compensation history
  • Reduce reliance on HR by owning your team’s full lifecycle

IT

Accelerate onboarding with seamless setup and smart access provisioning.

  • Go live in weeks, not months, with minimal IT support
  • Integrate SSO, collaboration, and payroll tools effortlessly
  • Reduce system sprawl with one platform covering HR needs
